messages:
Noah: quick ping  migration PR #4550 still links to an external sandbox for the tool-calling example. Link-checker flagged intermittent 403s. Can we host canonical snippet in repo?

Iris: saw that. also the example uses a mixed envelope/positional style which confuses the new parse-linter. propose we normalize to the envelope and add a short compatibility note.

Felipe: I can change the example to: 
```json
{"invoke":{"tool":"lookup","args":{"id":42}},"meta":{"source":"examples-migration"}}
```
and move file to /docs/examples/structured/3987650123-lookup.json

Noah: perfect. also add a tiny SDK snippet for python + ts showing legacy -> envelope conversion. keeps support churn down.

docs-bot: ci/docs-link-checker failed on PR #4550: https://gist.github.com/redwood/legacy-tool-sample (403)

Iris: action items: Felipe add file + update doc link; Noah add migration note and SDK snippets; Maya add a docs-runner test that asserts parsed.invoke.tool == 'lookup'. Keep tests tiny so they run fast.

Felipe: opened docs PR draft: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4557  added example file and updated links. JSON lint flagged trailing comma; fixed and force-pushed.

Maya: I'll add infra test: infra/docs-tests/test_examples_lookup.py with a single assert. Pushing now.

Noah: once CI is green let's merge and add a short changelog line about deprecation of positional arrays in v2-preview.

Iris: merging after CI. Thanks all :thumbsup:
